subject: Invoice delivery path and billing contact — SFTP primary, portal copies
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Bianchi <luca@heliohealth.eu>
Cc: AP Team <ap@heliohealth.eu>
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery path and billing contact — SFTP primary, portal copies

Hi Luca / Helio AP team,

Thanks for the conversation earlier. To make the onboarding smooth from a billing-side perspective, we can push invoices to your SFTP feed as the primary delivery mechanism and also publish copies to the HelioHealth billing portal for your audit trail. Quick questions to confirm our setup: 

- Billing contact (name + email) to include on the invoice and who should receive payment reminders?
- Do you want an invoice PDF only, or both XML (for AP system ingestion) and PDF copies?
- Your official VAT number and whether HelioHealth expects invoices issued net with reverse-charge noted (we will include VAT IDs / evidence as required).
- Will you be providing a PO number on each invoice or a master PO for the contract period?

We can name files in the SFTP as: redwood_invoice_[YYYYMMDD]_[INVOICE#].xml and keep a PDF sibling. Attached an example invoice XML so your AP can validate format.

Attachments: invoice_sample.xml (XML stub)

If SFTP is preferred we'll coordinate credentials and push schedule (daily batch or near-real-time for each invoice). If you prefer email copies instead of portal push we can do that as a fallback.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our billing ops to enable the push once we confirm.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Luca Bianchi <luca@heliohealth.eu>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap@heliohealth.eu>
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 18:42:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery path and billing contact — SFTP primary, portal copies

Hi Rachel,

Thanks — SFTP as primary is fine. Our AP contact is Giulia Russo <ap@heliohealth.eu>. Please send both XML and PDF; the XML will be ingested into our ERP. HelioHealth VAT ID: IT-12345678901 — reverse-charge applies for software services; please include a line on the invoice indicating VAT reverse-charge and our VAT ID.

We will provide PO numbers per quarter (master PO + line-level refs is fine). Also, can you confirm Redwood's policy on late fees? Our CFO wants to know if late interest is applied and how it appears on the invoice (separate line item or account-level policy).

We prefer portal copies retained for 7 years for audit, so if you can push both to SFTP and sync copies into our portal that would be ideal. If SFTP credentials are required from our side, Giulia will share them.

Regards,
Luca
Head of Finance, HelioHealth

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca@heliohealth.eu>, AP Team <ap@heliohealth.eu>
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Invoice delivery path and billing contact — SFTP primary, portal copies

Marissa / Connor — forwarding HelioHealth's preference. Key points: SFTP primary (XML + PDF), portal copies retained for 7 years, VAT reverse-charge (IT-12345678901), quarterly master PO with line refs, AP contact ap@heliohealth.eu.

Can billing ops: 
- Enable scheduled SFTP push for HelioHealth (file pattern: redwood_invoice_[YYYYMMDD]_[INV#].xml + .pdf).
- Configure portal copy push / webhook so their portal receives the same files.
- Ensure invoice XML includes a VAT element and a clear text line: "Reverse charge — VAT liability to recipient" when VAT ID present.
- Add a billing note about late fees: propose 1.5% monthly after 30 days (we can revise if legal wants different language).

Attaching their SFTP sample instructions if they send creds (I'll forward once received).

Thanks — Rachel

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca@heliohealth.eu>, AP Team <ap@heliohealth.eu>
Date: Thu, 05 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery path and billing contact — SFTP primary, portal copies

Rachel / Connor,

We can support the requested flow. Notes from ops: 
- Requirements: we need either (a) SFTP creds from Helio (preferred) or (b) SFTP endpoint we manage and Helio downloads. If they provide creds, we will drop files into the specified path.
- File formats: we'll deliver both XML (invoice_schema_v2) and PDF. Please confirm XML schema mapping — attached is our SFTP instructions and a short schema guide.
- VAT handling: we'll add an element <vat_note>Reverse charge — VAT liability to recipient. VAT ID will be included in <vat_id>. For audit evidence, we will include a metadata file per batch with invoice numbers and VAT IDs.
- Portal copies: we can post copies via their portal ingestion webhook or deliver to their portal inbox; will need an endpoint or API key from Helio. If they only want portal email copies, we can CC portal@heliohealth.eu.
- Late fees: we typically surface late interest as a separate line item labeled "Late fee (1.5%/month)" if billing/CS approves; for EU customers we prefer to include contractual language rather than automatic application until after escalation. If legal requires different wording we will update.

Next steps for Rachel: ask Helio to provide SFTP creds or give us the portal webhook API key + desired file retention. Also request their signed PO and VAT registration document for our records. Once we have creds, we'll schedule a one-off test push and confirm file ingestion.

Attachments: sftp_instructions.txt, portal_enroll_form.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Bianchi <luca@heliohealth.eu>, AP Team <ap@heliohealth.eu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Jun 2025 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery path and billing contact — SFTP primary, portal copies

Thanks Luca — appreciated. Per Marissa: please send SFTP credentials (host/path/user/key) or a portal webhook/api key and the signed PO + VAT certificate to ap@redwood.ai. We'll run a one-off test push once we have creds; expected file names will match redwood_invoice_YYYYMMDD_INV#.xml and the PDF sibling. 

On late fees: we will show a separate invoice line "Late fee (1.5%/month)" but our practice is to confirm application before automatic billing for EU customers; we'll mark the account with the proposed term and escalate to legal if Helio needs a different approach.

If you want, we can schedule a 15-minute call for Thursday to walk AP through test file and retention settings.

Best,
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
